data.name: Hisam
data.long_meaning: Hisam is derived from the Arabic root 'h-s-m', meaning 'to protect, guard, or preserve'. In Islamic history, Hisam ibn Salama (d. 11 AH) was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a notable early Muslim warrior. The name thus carries a strong spiritual significance in the context of protecting one's faith and community.
